{{Top}}
[[File:Netherworld_of_the_Force.png|thumb|200px|right|[[Denin]] and [[Vila]] begin their training with [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the Netherworld of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].]]
{{Quote|An old friend has learned the path to immortality. One who has returned from the Netherworld of the Force.|Yoda|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Netherworld of the Force''' was the place the souls of every being and creature apparently went after their physical bodies [[Death/Legends|died]]. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] went to this realm after dying but managed to return from it back to the physical universe as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]].<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] learned this ability from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] after he died upon the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]].<ref name="Rise">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Obi-Wan's spirit departed to this realm after having one final talk with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was also seen in this realm, where he reunited the recently deceased [[Vila]] with her brother [[Denin]] and promised he would train both of them.<ref name="SW92">[[Star Wars (1977) 92|''Star Wars'' (1977) 92]]</ref>

The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] didn't believe in the Netherworld of the Force as a supernatural phenomenon. He thought this so-called realm was in fact the reaction of a mind "dissipating into the hum of background energy" and accepting its fate. This feeling of peace would only be a normal consequence of the death. Plagueis also thought only the weak would tolerate the loss of their identity.<ref name="Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

The spirits of dead Dark Lords of the Sith were believed to inhabit [[Chaos/Legends|Chaos]] instead of the Netherworld of the Force.<ref name="Sith" />


==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In the rough draft Luke is asleep and struggling with thoughts of Vader and the dark side. Yoda and Ben are also present in the dream, and Luke berates Ben for not telling him that Vader is his father. Yoda explains that he'll soon be joining Ben in the Netherworld, and therefore he'll become stronger and will be better able to help Luke. Vader's voice reappears, and Luke awakens|First mention of the Netherworld in Episode VI's rough draft|<ref name="SW:TAS">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref>}}
The Netherworld of the Force was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="ROTS" /> However, the Netherworld had been first conceived by [[George Lucas]] as early as the revised rough draft of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="SW:TAS" />
